title: goniophlebium yunnanense
intro: Goniophlebium yunnanense, commonly known as the Yunnan fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Goniophlebium yunnanense include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation and muscle relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and stress relief.
